datasets.title: Maryland county population and unemployment rate
datasets.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau; Bureau of Labor Statistics
datasets.description: Reviewed Vintage 2024 county population estimates joined to BLS LAUS annual-average unemployment rates for every Maryland county and Baltimore city.

measures.label: Resident population
measures.observation: July 1 estimate for each year, all years from Vintage 2024
measures.aggregation: Sum only across disjoint counties in the same year and vintage

measures.label: Annual average unemployment rate
measures.definition: Unemployed persons divided by the civilian labor force (not total population)
measures.aggregation: Do not average county rates; sum unemployed and labor-force counts instead

sources.title: County Population Estimates, Vintage 2024
sources.verification: Snapshot source schema/coverage checked; domain reviewed

sources.title: Local Area Unemployment Statistics, county annual averages
sources.release: record source file hash and retrieval date; estimates may be revised
sources.verification: Snapshot source schema/coverage checked; domain reviewed

caveats: July 1 population and annual-average unemployment describe different temporal summaries.
The labor force is not the total population denominator.
A descriptive comparison does not establish causation.
All population observations use the same estimate vintage; missing values are never zero.

datasets.title: Maryland annual average temperature
datasets.description: Statewide January–December average temperature from NOAA Climate at a Glance (NClimDiv).

measures.label: Annual average temperature
measures.definition: Mean of monthly statewide average temperature, January–December
measures.aggregation: Do not average across years as a trend estimate

datasets.storage: Reviewed packaged snapshot; live publisher refresh available
caveats: Frozen historical demonstration, not current conditions or climate attribution.
Maryland statewide climate and Chesapeake watershed practices have different geography; no direct join or causal inference is supported.
Annual weather variability is not itself evidence of a long-term climate trend; two endpoints are not a trend estimate.
Published climate values may be revised; this snapshot records exact source hashes.

datasets.title: Chesapeake Bay watershed estimated cover-crop implementation
datasets.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Chesapeake Bay Program
datasets.description: Spatially allocated estimates of reported cover-crop implementation, summed across 50,871 NHDPlus V1 catchments.

measures.label: Estimated cover-crop area
measures.definition: Allocated area of reported cover-crop implementation
measures.aggregation: Do not add to tillage area; practices can overlap. Not an adoption rate.

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey / Chesapeake Bay Program

caveats: Frozen historical demonstration, not current conditions or climate attribution.
Maryland statewide climate and Chesapeake watershed practices have different geography; no direct join or causal inference is supported.
Spatially allocated estimates from reported practices, not direct measurements at every catchment. Practices were reported for soil/water-quality management, not proven climate-driven adoption.
Only listed observation years exist. Do not interpolate missing years or add cover-crop and tillage areas: practices can overlap.
